title: Backstage
content:
This is an internal page intended for IPEX DevOps team; to gather notes, links, questions, etc, pertaining to Backstage PoC/PoV.

Useful Links and Notes

  • Support forum: https://discord.com/invite/MUpMjP2

  • Current setup in Azure: https://app-backstage07.azurewebsites.net

  • Some additional info on hosting in Azure: https://www.blueboxes.co.uk/an-introduction-to-running-and-deploying-backstage-on-azure

  • Scaffolder templates and calling GitHub workflows: https://roadie.io/docs/details/scaffolder/

  • Backstage plugins: https://backstage.io/plugins

Open Questions

  • How will role separation (https://backstage.io/docs/overview/glossary ) work?

    • Can anyone add a template to the repository via pull-requests?

      • Repository permissions…

  • Should we bring in a frontend developer for further experimentation and development?

    • Asking in #devops channel?

  • What’s the timeline - what are the next steps from here?

    • When will we engage others with Backstage knowledge?

    • Internal priorities

      • Having weekly Backstage sessions? Thursdays?

  • Vague specification of certain YAML elements, like ui:options - where is that information?

  • Areas to automate…

  • Future: plugins to incorporate, asking in #devops channel, community meeting…

    • Requirements, gap analysis

  • Object (template) creation: Permissions?
